Text.Text: Sit down, if you like. I'm Marrok Dane. I have hunted on nine worlds, and this is the only one that hunts back. I am too old to go out there now, so my trophy wall is empty.
That one was for my knee. Here is your pay, from my own money and not the company's. That is one hunt done and three to go, so ask me about the others.
You are back. The rangers say there is an empty shell the size of a shuttle out there. Did you kill the Dragon Turtle?

Four beasts belong on it, and the first is the Dragon Turtle. Its shell turns blaster fire and its jaw goes through a speeder. I put eleven shots into one years ago, and it walked away with my left knee. I need you to kill one Dragon Turtle and come back to me here. I will pay you from my own purse.
Good. Kill one Dragon Turtle in the Desert, the Cave Ruins or the Grotto Caverns, then come back to me here at the landing. Take help, and do not stand in front of it.
You have to hit it from underneath or through the mouth, and both mean getting closer than you would like. Bring friends with you. I did not, and now I sit here.
You can find one in the Desert, the Cave Ruins or the Grotto Caverns. It goes wherever it likes, because nothing out there is able to argue with it.
I still need you to kill one Dragon Turtle. Look in the Desert, the Cave Ruins or the Grotto Caverns, and strike it from underneath or through the mouth. Then come back to me.
I heard it scream once from four kilometers away, and I am glad I never will again. Here is your purse. Ask me about the other hunts when you are ready.
You are back, and the sky has been empty for two days. I can hear the small animals coming out again. Did you kill the Chirodactyl?

I want the Chirodactyl. Its wingspan is wider than this landing pad, it hunts by sound, and last year it took a Czerka survey skiff right out of the air. I need you to find the Chirodactyl out in the wilds and kill it. Come back to me here when it is dead, and I will pay you from my own purse.
Good. Kill the Chirodactyl, then come back to me here at the landing. It ranges over the Grottos, the Mountains and the ruins, so keep looking up.
It ranges over the Grottos, the Mountains and their caves, the ruins and the western Desert. Some days it is not out at all, so you may have to come back and look again.
When it screams, your ears will tell you to run. Do not run, because the Chirodactyl strikes at whatever is moving.
I still need you to kill the Chirodactyl. It ranges over the Grottos, the Mountains, the ruins and the western Desert, and it is not out every day. Come back to me when it is dead.
Here is your purse. I also cut this Rancor-Hide Belt from the hide for you, and I ruined a vibrosaw doing it. Nothing on this planet will cut it off you.
You are back and you are still walking, and I see you brought the hide. Did you kill the Rancor?

It is all true. Every Rancor you have seen in a crime lord's pit was taken from here as a calf, and the ones nobody took grew up wild. One of them belongs on my list, and I do not care which. I need you to kill one Rancor and come back to me here. I will pay you and make you something from its hide.
Good. Kill one Rancor in the Grottos, the Mountains, the ruins or the western Desert, then come back to me here. Bring a piece of the hide, because I know a use for it.
They wander the Grottos, the Mountains, the ruins and the western Desert, but they are not out every day. You will know when one is near, because you can feel it in the ground.
You kill it slowly and from several directions at once. The hide is the trouble, because nothing gets through it quickly, so bring help.
I still need you to kill one Rancor. They roam the Grottos, the Mountains, the ruins and the western Desert, and they are not out every day. Come back to me when it is dead.
Then take my ring, the Canopy Stalker's Band. Every mark inside it is a day I followed that thing and lived. Here is your purse as well.
You are back, and the beasts have been making ordinary noise for three days. Did you kill the Dark Side Adept?

I meant one person in particular. A robed figure walks among the beasts out there, and they let it pass. The rangers call it a Dark Side Adept, and it kills everyone who finds it. I tracked it for a month. I need you to find the Dark Side Adept and kill it, then come back to me. I will give you my ring and a purse.
Good. Kill the Dark Side Adept, then come back to me here at the landing. It walks the Grottos, the Mountains, the ruins and the western Desert. My ring is yours when you return.
No, and I will not put it on the wall. But it kills everyone who finds it, and it has been finding people on purpose. I will sleep better when it is dead.
You cannot track it. Walk the Grottos, the Mountains and the ruins, and it will choose the day. When the beasts all go quiet at once, the adept is close.
I still need you to kill the Dark Side Adept. It walks the Grottos, the Mountains, the ruins and the western Desert, but not every day. When the beasts go quiet, it is close.
It is. I have nothing left to pay you with except what I know, so everything I learned out there is yours. Go and find yourself a tenth world to hunt.
There you are. Stand back and look at the wall with me. It holds four hunts and your name. What do you think of it?

No, it is not. You brought down the Dragon Turtle, the Chirodactyl, the Rancor and the Dark Side Adept. I spent thirty years thinking I would be the one to do it, and I find I do not mind. There is nothing left to hunt for me. All I ask is that you let me put your name on the wall.
Good. I have carved your name under mine, which is only there because I built the wall. Talk to me again and take a proper look at it.
Good hunting to you, old man.
Tell me about your other hunts.
Yes, the Dragon Turtle is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring down a Dragon Turtle for you.
Not right now. Your knee is warning enough.
How do I kill a Dragon Turtle?
Where does the Dragon Turtle live?
What do you want to put on your trophy wall?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the Dragon Turtle hunt.
Yes, the Chirodactyl is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll hunt the Chirodactyl for you.
Not right now. I prefer prey on the ground.
Where should I look for the Chirodactyl?
Do you have any advice for fighting it?
What flying beast do you want hunted?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the Chirodactyl hunt.
Yes, the Rancor is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll kill a Rancor for you.
Not right now. Nobody kills a Rancor alone.
Where can I find a Rancor?
How does anyone manage to kill a Rancor?
Is it true that Rancors live on Dathomir?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the Rancor hunt.
Yes, the Dark Side Adept is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll find the Dark Side Adept and kill it.
Not right now. I do not cross the dark side.
Is it right to hunt a person as a trophy?
How do I track the Dark Side Adept?
What did you mean when you said this world hunts back?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the Dark Side Adept.
It is a good wall, Marrok.
I will look at it in a moment.
I will look at it in a moment.
Go ahead and put my name on it.
Not yet. Give me a little time.
Your trophy wall is not empty any more.
